evidence.expiry: 限セクション『(ヒットなし)』=コンセッション/特許束のような期限型独占に依存しない(ブランド/サブスク業態)→no
evidence.geopol: 集ヒットは『Financial instruments, which potentially subject us to concentration of risk, are cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities. Cash is placed with major financial institutions』のみ=金融商品の集中に限られ、地理/顧客の集中懸念なし。米国内報道中心→0(軽微)
evidence.moatdecay: 堀劣化の直接ヒットなし。機械系列で売上1,748.6→2,824.9百万(2018-25)・営利190.2→431.6百万の一貫増、roict/gmt=up→堀は劣化していない→no(機械系列根拠)
evidence.p4: 『material weakness』ヒットは監査手続の定型文(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness』)=実指摘ではない。『Unresolved Staff Comments』はItem1B目次見出しの出現のみ。『updating the design and documentation of our internal control...which went live in the first quarter of 2026』=新ERP稼働に伴う定型的な統制更新で重大な不備の報告なし。accr=-8.0(<0)と併せ→90

evidence.moatW: 収益内訳(FY2025 10-K, 総額2,824,918千$): 購読1,950,778=69.1%(うちデジタルのみ購読1,434,336=全社50.8%、印刷購読516,442=18.3%) / 広告565,993=20.0% / アフィリエイト・ライセンス等308,147=10.9%(出典: 10-K 2025-12-31 Revenue - Subscription, Advertising, and Other Revenues R48・Digital-only R49)。報告セグメントは1つ(同 Segment Information R94『Reportable Segment』単一)。ゲーム/料理/The Athletic/Wirecutter等は同一の編集局・ブランド・バンドル購読基盤に乗り、かつ単独で売上15%以上として開示されないため独立堀に数えられない。ただし顧客は個人購読者『approximately 12.78 million total subscribers』で最大顧客<10%、最大収益ライン69.1%<70%、用途もニュース/ゲーム/料理/スポーツ/商品レビューへ分散。→ 独立した堀は1本だが用途・顧客が分散=70
evidence.dom: 支配シェア: 原本『In the United States, The Times had the largest daily and Sunday print circulation of all seven-day newspapers for the six-month period ended September 30, 2025, according to data collected by the Alliance for Audited Media』、総購読者『approximately 12.78 million total subscribers』(出典: 10-K 2025-12-31 Item 1 Business)。原本の有料ニュース競合列挙『The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, CNN, BBC News, The Guardian, Financial Times, ESPN』にNYTを上回る規模の記載はなく、第三者監査(AAM)で全米首位=米有料一般ニュース購読市場の寡占リーダー。→ 寡占40-69%=70と判定。ただし%シェアの開示はなく、原本の競争記述は『We operate in a highly competitive environment ... from companies such as Apple, Alphabet, ByteDance, Meta Platforms, Microsoft, OpenAI, Perplexity and X』とプラットフォーム/AIまで含み、広義の注意市場で見ればシェアは僅少。本判定は有料ニュース購読を市場と定義した場合の推定(採取時nullを本監査で補填・%開示なし)
evidence.irr: 代替不能性=50(代替容易)。原本Item 1『COMPETITION』: “We operate in a highly competitive environment subject to rapid and, at times, unpredictable change and face significant competition in all aspects of our business. We compete for audience, subscribers, advertising and licensees against a wide variety of companies, including content creators, providers and distributors; news aggregators; search engines; social media platforms; streaming services; and AI companies”、競合列挙は “The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, CNN, BBC News, The Guardian, Financial Times, ESPN” および “Apple, Alphabet, ByteDance, Meta Platforms, Microsoft, OpenAI, Perplexity and X”。購読は長期契約・データ移行・認証のロックがなく、自社も “Our access model for our digital products generally offers users who have registered free access to a limited amount of content” と無料の部分代替を提供。唯一供給(100)・認証ロック(85)・高摩擦(70)の原本根拠なし → 50。出典: 10-K 2025-12-31 Item 1 Business - COMPETITION / PRODUCTS / 出典URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/71691/000007169126000011/nyt-20251231.htm
evidence.rep: 複製障壁=80(極困難)。原本Item 1: “The quality of our coverage has been widely recognized with many industry and peer accolades, including more Pulitzer Prizes and citations than any other news organization” / “The Times's print newspaper, which commenced publication in 1851” / “The Company was incorporated on August 26, 1896” / “As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 6,000 full-time equivalent employees, which includes more than 3,000 involved in our journalism operations” / “approximately 12.78 million subscribers across 234 countries and territories”。3,000人超の常設編集局と174年分の受賞・信頼の蓄積は資金だけでは即時に買えず数十年規模。ただし原本自身がWSJ/WaPo/FT等の同型有料ニュース事業者を競合として列挙しており『複製不能(100)』ではないため80。出典: 10-K 2025-12-31 Item 1 Business - OVERVIEW / PRODUCTS / SUBSCRIBERS AND AUDIENCE / HUMAN CAPITAL / 出典URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/71691/000007169126000011/nyt-20251231.htm
evidence.dur: 堀の型=55(ブランド)。原本Item 1『COMPETITION』: “Competition for subscription revenue and audience is generally based upon content format and breadth, depth, originality, quality, relevance and timeliness; reputation and brand strength; product experience; visibility on search engines and social media platforms and in mobile app stores...”、および “We believe that The Times's original, independent and high-quality reporting, storytelling and journalistic excellence across topics and formats set us apart from others and are at the heart of what makes our journalism worth paying for”。競争軸が『評判とブランド力』であることを自社が明記。規制/プロセス知/物理(100)でもネットワーク効果(85)でもスイッチングコスト(75)でもない(購読は随時解約可でロックの記述なし) → ブランド型55。出典: 10-K 2025-12-31 Item 1 Business - COMPETITION / 出典URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/71691/000007169126000011/nyt-20251231.htm
